title: Ask for a location carefully
summary: Geolocation asks the browser for a location.
introduction: Geolocation asks the browser for a location. Your task: Describe a manual alternative when permission is refused.
learningObjectives: Describe a manual alternative when permission is refused.
Explain the example for ask for a location carefully

blocks.text: Geolocation asks the browser for a location. The person can refuse, and the answer may be approximate.

Use these examples in a local page in a current browser. APIs involving files, storage, clipboard or location may need HTTPS, a user action or permission. They are shown as code because this site's sandbox limits those features.

blocks.title: Ask for a location carefully

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `getCurrentPosition` takes success and failure callbacks. The browser asks permission and may report an approximate location.

blocks.text: When used after an appropriate user action on a secure page, it reports accuracy or a handled failure.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Explain why location is useful before asking. Do not require it for a task that can work with a manual choice.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Describe a manual alternative when permission is refused.
